{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
'''Shimmersilk''' was a sheer, lustrous fabric used to make expensive clothing favored by many members of high society, such as [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]] such as [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]. [[Lanoree Brock]] wore shimmersilk robes.

{{Clothes-stub}}
